text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome. Lady Cesario, 
Lady Daring Heart, Lady Rhein Kraft, Lady 
Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu has informed us of your visit. 
Allow me to guide you to your rooms first, 
please come inside.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
You will be staying in these guest rooms. 
There is a private room for each of you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh, what a gorgeous room...!! 
Is it really okay for us to stay here... 
!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
This is the training gym. 
You are free to use it at any time during 
your stay.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text: And this is the training course.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wow... It's huge... 
So this is where Ramonu-san has been 
honing her legs...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Two whole days training here with 
Ramonu-san... 
Is it really okay for us to enjoy such 
luxury...!
—A few hours earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Let us prepare for the ceremony. 
You girls should come along too. To my 
estate."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Huh...? By ceremony... do you mean the 
unveiling show?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You will be racing, will you not? 
—I want it to be a wonderful ceremony, you 
see."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"You mean... we'll be making adjustments 
together 
for the race following the ceremony of 
vows...?! Are you sure we can join you?!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Pre-race adjustments with Ramonu-san...!! 
Yes, please! We would be honored!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"It's decided, then. 
Starting today, for two nights and three 
days. I will send a car for you at once."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The actual training starts tomorrow 
morning, right? 
I wonder what kind of menu is waiting for 
us... Hehe, I can't wait.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Butler
text_block_list.text:
—Ladies, would you care to have tea in the 
garden afterwards? 
Lady Ramonu is waiting for you.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um... thank you so much, once again. 
For treating us so generously.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Don't mind it. Please, help yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Truly, we are so grateful for such a rare 
opportunity... 
and for your kind hospitality. We look 
forward to working with you these next two 
days.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, though, I never dreamed 
we would be allowed 
to accompany someone of your stature, 
Ramonu-senpai, in training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Think nothing of it. 
I am merely... waiting for you to blossom. 
That is all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Tell me, girls. What will you swear at 
the ceremony?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"At the ceremony of vows, right? 
In that case, I will swear my resolve!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to claim the Tiara in the 
Twinkle Series and become 
the ultimate Queen. I intend to declare 
and swear to that once more."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I have a goal I want to swear to! 
Throughout the long, 
unbroken history of the Tiara, I want to 
etch my own results and carry it forward 
into the future—!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I will swear my determination. With these 
legs inherited from my mother, I will 
prove my strength without fail... 
and vindicate her regrets. That is the 
determination I wish to pledge once 
again."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I will swear toward the future. To leave 
my mark on the Tiara route and use those 
achievements 
as a foundation for the future is my great 
ambition. I intend to swear to the future 
we will build beyond that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...How noble.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"—Um, Ramonu-san, what will you be 
swearing? 
You said you wanted to hold a ceremony, so 
you must have something in mind!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"——My love. 
A madness that scorches my heart... to my 
dearly missed 'beloved.'"
—The next morning.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally time for Ramonu-san's 
training! 
We were told to come to this room for now, 
but where is Ramonu-san—"

text_block_list.name: Esthetician A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu, please proceed to the bed in 
the far back.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Esthetician B
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, welcome! 
Two at a time, please take your places on 
these beds～!"

text_block_list.name: Craft & Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? 
—What?"

text_block_list.name: Esthetician B
text_block_list.text:
We'll begin with the cranial alignment 
treatment~.

text_block_list.name: Craft & Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow, ow, OW~~~~!! 
Ow, ow, ow, OW!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Owwwww, it hurts, it hurts, it HURTS!! 
Something's making weird popping 
soundsーー!

text_block_list.name: Esthetician B
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry~ By massaging and adjusting 
the shape of your skull, it contours your 
face to make it smaller~ It hurts at 
first, but you'll get used to it 
gradually~.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A-Are you sure...?! T-This is... my bones! 
Is it really oーーAh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Phew. That feels so good...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Um. What on earth is that for...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It's an instrument to improve blood 
circulation.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Circulation... Right, of course, that 
makes sense... 
So it's body maintenance...? This counts 
as conditioning, too...?

text_block_list.name: Esthetician A
text_block_list.text:
Lady Ramonu. We are ready for your 
full-body treatment. 
Right this way, please.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
A full-body aesthetic clinic, too...?! How 
professional...! 
...Wait, professional...?

text_block_list.name: Esthetician B
text_block_list.text:
Oops, let's make sure to use the face 
roller properly first~! Roll it firmly 
along your jawline down to your neck, 
tracing the contours.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, this is all for race prep and 
conditioning, right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Who knows—wait, ...no, I assume the 
intention is overall body maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels much more geared toward 
beauty care than sports medicine, wouldn't 
you say...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? But hey, they're the Mejiro 
family, after all! Maybe it just feels 
that way because it's so royal! ...Maybe?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Yes, it must be! Blood 
vessels in the neck are, like, super 
crucial, after all!
